meta: Fact-check viral health news with AI: claims like "drink this and cure that" are usually wrong, yet they spread the fastest.

muc.title: Viral health news
muc.text: Health claims like "drink this and cure that" are usually wrong, yet they get shared the fastest.

muc.title: Three suspicious signs
muc.text: Three red flags: promises of a quick cure, no clear source, and pressure to share it right away.

muc.title: Let AI split the claims
muc.text: Remove the sender's name, paste the message into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask it to split out each claim to check.

muc.title: Doctors make the call
muc.text: Then check the health authority's or a major hospital's website. AI helps you check; how to treat it is up to a doctor.

muc.title: Check one group message
muc.text: Take a health message from your family group chat and ask AI to point out the red flags.
